title: Database disk full from runaway export job
reason: The diagnosis correctly points to the PostgreSQL disk being filled by the continuous export job.
root_cause: The continuously running export job writes large CSV files to the PostgreSQL data volume, filling /var/lib/postgresql to 100% usage and causing PostgreSQL to fail with 'No space left on device' errors, which leads to order processing failures and admin export timeouts.
truth: A new data export job runs every minute and writes large CSV files to /var/lib/postgresql/exports, filling the 50 GB database disk so PostgreSQL cannot write new data.
check_first: Check the db container logs and performance metrics (e.g., pg_stat_activity, CPU/disk I/O).
